name: Successful Logon
meaning: An account successfully logged on to a computer.
whyItMatters: Tracks successful access. High volume might indicate successful brute force if preceded by 4625.
socUseCase: Tracking lateral movement or successful brute force attacks.
suspiciousExample: Logon type 3 from an unexpected external IP address.
benignExample: Normal user logging into their workstation in the morning.

name: Failed Logon
meaning: An account failed to log on.
whyItMatters: Can indicate brute force or password spraying attacks.
socUseCase: Detecting brute force or password spraying.
suspiciousExample: 15 failed logons from the same IP address for different usernames in 1 minute.
investigationQuestions: Is this a single user or multiple?
Is the source IP internal or external?
